name: shardx-mcp

tools.name: profile_list
tools.description: List persistent profiles with their running state and CDP endpoint.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Get a profile's full stored config by id.

tools.name: profile_create
tools.description: Create a persistent profile. If `fingerprint` is omitted, a new one is generated for `platform` (or the host OS). `proxy` is a string added to the store; `folder` files it.

tools.name: profile_create_temporary
tools.description: Create a TEMPORARY profile (hidden from the list, auto-deleted on close). Random/specified fingerprint, optional inline proxy string.

tools.name: profile_edit
tools.description: Edit a profile. Only provided fields change; `fingerprint` replaces it verbatim; folder:'' unfiles; proxy_id:'' unbinds.

tools.name: profile_delete
tools.description: Delete a profile (config + user-data-dir).

tools.name: profile_start
tools.description: Start this profile now with CDP; do not call list_running first. Safe to call when it may already be running. Returns status, pid, and CDP endpoint.

tools.name: profile_stop
tools.description: Stop a profile's browser gracefully. Call only when the user asks to close it or the browser is no longer needed.

tools.name: profile_list_running
tools.description: Inspect profiles that are already running. Do not use this as a prerequisite for start_profile or any browser tool.

tools.name: fingerprint_new
tools.description: Generate a fresh uniquified fingerprint (random platform_version, host-aware CPU/RAM, clamped screen). Not persisted.

tools.name: fingerprint_list
tools.description: List the fingerprint library entries.

tools.name: folder_list
tools.description: List folder tags.

tools.name: folder_rename
tools.description: Rename a folder (retags its profiles).

tools.name: folder_delete
tools.description: Delete a folder. delete_profiles=true removes its profiles; false unfiles them.

tools.name: proxy_list
tools.description: List stored proxies (no credentials).

tools.name: proxy_add
tools.description: Add a proxy to the store. Pass `proxy` as a string (scheme://user:pass@host:port) or explicit fields.

tools.name: proxy_delete
tools.description: Delete a stored proxy by id.

tools.name: profile_cookies_export
tools.description: Export a profile's cookies (decrypted).

tools.name: profile_cookies_import
tools.description: Import cookies into a STOPPED profile.

tools.name: browser_navigation
tools.description:
Run one browser navigation action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_navigate: Open a URL in the profile's browser (starts it with CDP if needed). Set headless to launch without a window.
browser_current_url: Return the active page's current URL and title.
browser_back: Go back in history.
browser_forward: Go forward in history.
browser_reload: Reload the active page.
browser_wait_for_selector: Wait until an element matching the selector reaches a state.
browser_wait_for_load: Wait for a page load state (load | domcontentloaded | networkidle).
browser_wait: Wait a fixed number of milliseconds.
browser_wait_for_url: Wait until the page URL matches (glob/substring).
browser_wait_for_function: Wait until a JS expression evaluates truthy in the page.

profile_id.description: Used by browser_navigate. See the action description for its meaning.

url.description: Used by browser_navigate. See the action description for its meaning.

headless.description: Used by browser_navigate. See the action description for its meaning.

selector.description: Used by browser_wait_for_selector. See the action description for its meaning.

state.description: Used by browser_wait_for_selector. See the action description for its meaning.

timeout_ms.description: Used by browser_wait_for_selector. See the action description for its meaning.

ms.description: Used by browser_wait. See the action description for its meaning.

expression.description: Used by browser_wait_for_function. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description:
Run one browser read action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_evaluate: Run a JavaScript expression in the active page and return the result.
browser_content: Return the active page's full HTML.
browser_get_text: Return innerText of the first element matching the selector.
browser_get_attribute: Return an attribute of the first element matching the selector.
browser_get_html: Return outerHTML of a selector (or the whole document when omitted).
browser_exists: Whether at least one element matches the selector.
browser_count: Count elements matching the selector.
browser_links: List anchor links on the page as { text, href }.
browser_text: Return the page's visible text (document.body.innerText) — cheap way to read content.
browser_element_state: Element state: count, visible, enabled, checked.
browser_bounding_box: Bounding box {x,y,width,height} of an element (or null if not visible).
browser_get_texts: innerText of ALL elements matching the selector (scrape lists/tables).
browser_input_value: Current value of an input / textarea / select.
browser_aria_snapshot: Accessibility-tree snapshot of the page (or a selector) — a compact, agent-friendly view of the UI.

profile_id.description: Used by browser_evaluate. See the action description for its meaning.

expression.description: Used by browser_evaluate. See the action description for its meaning.

selector.description: Used by browser_get_text. See the action description for its meaning.

name.description: Used by browser_get_attribute. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_interact
tools.description:
Run one browser interact action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_click: Click the first element matching a CSS selector.
browser_fill: Fill an input/textarea matching a CSS selector with text.
browser_type: Type text into an element key-by-key (good for inputs that watch keystrokes).
browser_press: Press a keyboard key on the active page (e.g. Enter, Escape, Control+A, ArrowDown).
browser_hover: Hover the first element matching the selector.
browser_select_option: Select an option in a <select> by value (or label).
browser_set_checkbox: Check or uncheck a checkbox/radio.
browser_focus: Focus the first element matching the selector.
browser_scroll: Scroll: to an element (selector) or by a pixel delta (dy / dx).
browser_set_files: Set files on a file <input> (upload).
browser_double_click: Double-click an element.
browser_right_click: Right-click (context-menu) an element.
browser_drag: Drag one element onto another.
browser_mouse_click: Click at absolute viewport coordinates (for canvas/maps).
browser_scroll_to_bottom: Scroll to the bottom of the page (triggers lazy/infinite load).
browser_insert_text: Insert text into the focused element (fast; no per-key events).
browser_dialog: Auto-handle native dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt). action: accept | dismiss | off.
browser_press_on: Press a key while a specific element is focused (e.g. Enter in a search box).

selector.description: Used by browser_click. See the action description for its meaning.

text.description: Used by browser_fill. See the action description for its meaning.

delay_ms.description: Used by browser_type. See the action description for its meaning.

key.description: Used by browser_press. See the action description for its meaning.

value.description: Used by browser_select_option. See the action description for its meaning.

by.description: Used by browser_select_option. See the action description for its meaning.

checked.description: Used by browser_set_checkbox. See the action description for its meaning.

dy.description: Used by browser_scroll. See the action description for its meaning.

dx.description: Used by browser_scroll. See the action description for its meaning.

paths.description: Used by browser_set_files. See the action description for its meaning.

from.description: Used by browser_drag. See the action description for its meaning.

to.description: Used by browser_drag. See the action description for its meaning.

x.description: Used by browser_mouse_click. See the action description for its meaning.

y.description: Used by browser_mouse_click. See the action description for its meaning.

dialog_action.description: Used by browser_dialog. See the action description for its meaning.

prompt_text.description: Used by browser_dialog. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description:
Run one browser tabs action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_list_tabs: List open tabs as { index, url, title, active }.
browser_open_tab: Open a new tab (optionally navigating to a URL) and make it active.
browser_switch_tab: Make the tab at `index` (from browser_list_tabs) the active one.
browser_close_tab: Close a tab by index (defaults to the active tab).

profile_id.description: Used by browser_list_tabs. See the action description for its meaning.

url.description: Used by browser_open_tab. See the action description for its meaning.

index.description: Used by browser_switch_tab. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_capture
tools.description:
Run one browser capture action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_screenshot: Screenshot the active page (PNG).
browser_element_screenshot: Screenshot a single element (PNG).
browser_set_viewport: Set the page viewport size.
browser_pdf: Render the active page to PDF (headless Chromium only). Returns base64.
browser_wait_for_download: Wait for a download to start, save it into `dir`, and return the saved path.

profile_id.description: Used by browser_screenshot. See the action description for its meaning.

full_page.description: Used by browser_screenshot. See the action description for its meaning.

selector.description: Used by browser_element_screenshot. See the action description for its meaning.

width.description: Used by browser_set_viewport. See the action description for its meaning.

height.description: Used by browser_set_viewport. See the action description for its meaning.

dir.description: Used by browser_wait_for_download. See the action description for its meaning.

timeout_ms.description: Used by browser_wait_for_download. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_storage
tools.description:
Run one browser storage action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_get_cookies: Return the browser context's cookies (live, from the running browser).
browser_set_cookies: Add cookies to the browser context (Playwright format: name, value, and domain+path or url).
browser_clear_cookies: Clear all cookies in the browser context.
browser_local_storage: Read/write the page's localStorage. action: get | set | remove | clear.

key.description: Used by browser_local_storage. See the action description for its meaning.

value.description: Used by browser_local_storage. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_frames
tools.description:
Run one browser frames action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_frames: List the page's frames as { index, name, url }.
browser_frame_evaluate: Evaluate JS inside a frame matched by URL substring or name.

profile_id.description: Used by browser_frames. See the action description for its meaning.

frame.description: Used by browser_frame_evaluate. See the action description for its meaning.

expression.description: Used by browser_frame_evaluate. See the action description for its meaning.

tools.name: browser_network
tools.description:
Run one browser network action. Choose action and provide its fields at the top level. Browser actions auto-start stopped profiles.
browser_set_extra_headers: Set extra HTTP headers sent on every request (e.g. Authorization). Empty object clears.
browser_block_resources: Abort matching resource types for speed (image, media, font, stylesheet, script, …). Empty list unblocks.
browser_wait_for_response: Wait for a response whose URL matches (glob/substring); returns { url, status }.
browser_capture_start: Start logging finished network requests for the profile.
browser_capture_stop: Stop logging and return the captured requests.
browser_mock: Fulfill requests matching a URL glob with a canned response (status/body/content_type).
browser_unmock: Remove a mock for a pattern (or all mocks when omitted).
browser_intercept: Modify matching requests in flight: override/add request headers, replace POST data, or abort. Remove with browser_unmock.
browser_set_network_conditions: Emulate network via CDP: offline, latency, and throughput (kbps). Omit/false/0 to reset to unlimited.

headers.description: Used by browser_set_extra_headers. See the action description for its meaning.

types.description: Used by browser_block_resources. See the action description for its meaning.

url_pattern.description: Used by browser_wait_for_response. See the action description for its meaning.

timeout_ms.description: Used by browser_wait_for_response. See the action description for its meaning.

status.description: Used by browser_mock. See the action description for its meaning.

body.description: Used by browser_mock. See the action description for its meaning.

content_type.description: Used by browser_mock. See the action description for its meaning.

post_data.description: Used by browser_intercept. See the action description for its meaning.

abort.description: Used by browser_intercept. See the action description for its meaning.

offline.description: Used by browser_set_network_conditions. See the action description for its meaning.

instructions:
Use ShardX profiles directly and deliberately:
- If a profile id is unknown, call profile_list once to choose it.
- If the user asks to launch, open, or run a profile, call profile_start immediately. Never call profile_list_running first.
- Browser tools auto-start a valid stopped profile, so profile_list_running is not a prerequisite for browser work.
- profile_list_running is only for an explicit status/diagnostic request.
- Keep a profile running across related browser calls. Call profile_stop only when the user asks or when cleanup is clearly requested.
- Every grouped browser tool has an action-specific schema. Supply action and that action's fields at the top level.
